book.name: HECHOS
book.title: HECHOS LUKAS KILLKARKAN JESUKRISTUPA AKLLASHKAN RUNAKUNA RURASHKANKUNATA

content: Saulo Jesukristuta kreyik runakunata sufrichirkansapa.

Chashna chay chiknik runakuna Estebanta wañuchiykaptinkuna Saulopish rimarkan allimi wañuchinankunaka. Esteban wañuptinna Jesukristuta kreyik runakuna sukaman wakakushpa pamparkansapa. Chay diyamanta Jerusalenpi kawsak runakuna Jesukristuta kreyik runakunata chiknishpa kallarirkansapa sufrichiyta. Chayrayku paykuna manchakuywan Judea partiman Samaria partiman nitikurkansapa. Paykuna nitikushpankunapish chay alli yachachikuk runakuna mana nitikurkansapachu.
Chaykamanka Sauloka Jesukristuta kreyik runakunata chiknishpa sukaman sufrichirkansapa. Wasin wasinpi yaykushpa ullkukunata warmikunata apirkansapa pushanankunapa karselpi wichkachik.
Felipi Tata Diospa rimananta yachachikurkan Samaria llaktapi.
Chashna Jesukristuta kreyik runakuna Jerusalenmanta nitikushpankuna maypicha chayashpankuna yachachikuksapa Jesukristu salvakuk kananta.
Felipi nitikushpa Samaria partipi ashwan atun llaktapi chayarkan. Chaypi chayashpa Jesukristu yachakushkanta kallarirkan yachachikuyta.
Chay llaktapi kawsak runakuna sukaman kushikushpankuna aypa milagrukunata ruraptin kawashpankuna Felipita allita uyarirkansapa.

Felipika aypa supayadu runakunatapish alliyachirkansapa. Chay supaykuna unkuchishkan runakunamanta kaparikushpa llukshirkansapa. Chaymanta aypa mana kuyuy atipak aypa mana puriy atipak runakunata alliyachirkansapa.
Chashna aypa unkudukunata sanuyachiptinkuna chay llaktapi kawsakkuna sukaman kushikurkansapa.
Chay llaktapi kawsarkan suk runa Simon. Ñawpa chay Simonka ñakakushpa kawsak. Ñakakushpa aypa runakunata llullachishpa kreyichirkan sumak yachayuk kananta.
Tukuy chay llaktapi kawsakkuna taksha atun paytaka sukaman allita uyarishpa willaksapa: “Tata Dios yanapaptin kay runaka sukaman yachaysapami.”
Aypa watakunata chay Simonka ñakakushpa chay runakunata llullachirkansapa. Chayrayku willashkankunata sukaman manchashpankuna kasuksapa.
Chay llaktapi Felipika yachachikurkan Tata Dios kamachikuk kananta Jesukristu salvakuk kananta. Chaypina aypa ullkukuna warmikuna yachachikunanta kreyishpankuna bawtisakurkansapa.
Chay Simonpish Jesukristuta kreyishpa bawtisakurkan. Chashna bawtisakushpa Felipiwan tantalla purirkan. Sukaman almirarkan Felipi almirana milagrukunata ruraptin.

Chaypina Jerusalenpi chay yachachikuk runakunaka yacharkansapa Samariapi aypa runakuna Tata Diospa rimananta kreyinankunata. Chayta yachashpankuna Pedruwan Juanta kacharkansapa ashwan allita yachachikunankunapa.
Pedruwan Juanka Samariapi chayashpankuna Tata Diosta roygarkansapa chay mushuk kreyikukkunapish Espiritunta chaskinankunapa.
Chay runakuna Jesuspa shutinllapira bawtisakurkansapa. Tata Diospa Espiritunka manara paykunaman shamurkanrachu.
Chaypina Pedruwan Juan chay runakunapa umankunapi makinkunata churaptinkuna Tata Diospa Espiritunta chaskirkansapa.
Chayta kawashpa chay Simonka Pedruta Juanta kullkita pagaranayarkan.
Willarkansapa: —Ñukatapish yachachiwaychi atipanaynipa runakunapi makinikunata churaptini Tata Diospa Espiritunta chaskinankunapa.
Chashna willaptinna Pedruka willarkan: —Kanka yuyanki ñukata kullkita pagarawaptiki Tata Dios yanapashunaykita. Chashna yuyaykuptiki Tata Dios sukaman kastigashunka.
Tata Diospa ñawpakninpi mana alli yuyayuk runa kanki. Chashna yuyaykuptiki payka mana yanapashunkichu.
Chay mana alli yuyanaykimanta wanashpa Tata Diosta roygay perdonashunaykipa.
Ñukaka kawayki uchaykillapira kaptiki. Kunankaman ñakakushkaykita mana wanankichu.
Chashna Pedru willaptin Simonka aynirkan: —Kankunaka Tata Diosta roygapaychi ama rimashkaykichitashina kastigawananpa.

Chay llaktapi Juanwan Pedruka Tata Diospa rimananta allita yachachikurkansapa. Chaymanta Samaria partipi aypa llaktillukunapi Jesus yachachishkankunata yachachikuyllapi rirkansapa Jerusalenpi chayanankunakaman.
Felipi Etiopiya llaktamanta kamachikuk runata yachachirkan.
Chaymanta Pedruwan Juan kutishkankunawasha Tata Diospa angelnin Felipita willarkan: —Rillay Jerusalenmanta Gasa rina ñanta. Chay ñanka chunlla chakidu partita rin.

Chashna chay angel willaptinna Felipika rirkan. Chay ñanpi suk Etiopiyamanta runawan tinkunakurkan. Chay runaka Etiopiya llaktapi kamachikuk warmipa kullkinta kuydak karkan. Payka Tata Diosta kuyak rishkanwasha Jerusalenmanta llaktanman kutiykarkan.
Kaballu aysaptin karrunpi tiyaridu riykarkan. Chashna karrunpi riykashpa ñawpa yachachikuk Isaiyaspa killkadunta leyiykarkan.
Chaypina Tata Diospa Espiritunka Felipitaka willarkan: —Mash chay karruta ladunchay.
Chaypina Felipi ladunchashpa uyarirkan chay ñawpa Isaiyaspa killkadunta leyiykaptin. Chaypina chay runataka tapurkan: —¿Ariya entiendinkichu kay killkadu leyiykanaykita?
Chashna tapuptinna chay runaka aynirkan: —Mana ni pi yachachiwaptinka ¿imashnatí atipasha entiendiyta? Chaypina Felipita roygarkan karrunpi yaykushpa ladunpi tiyarinanpa.
Chay runa Tata Diospa rimanan leyishkanka kashna riman:

content.text: “Tata Diosmanta shamudu runata suk ovejatashina pusharkansapa wañuchik.
Suk oveja mana nima kaparinchu millwanta tipipuptinkuna.
Chashnashina Tata Diosmanta shamudu runata sufrichiptinkuna mana nima kaparirkanchu.
Wañuchishkankunarayku payta kreyikkuna mana yupaypa layata aypayankasapa.”

content: Chayta leyishkanwasha chay Etiopiyamanta runaka Felipita tapurkan: —May willaway. Chay ñawpa yachachikuk runaka ¿kikinpachu killkarkan chikan runapachu?
Chaypina Felipika chay runa leyishkan Isaiyaspa killkadunmanta yachachirkan Jesus salvakuk kananta.
Chaypina riykashpankuna suk yakuta kawashpa chay runaka Felipita willarkan: —Mash kaway chay yakuta. ¿Manachu kay yakupika ñukata bawtisawankiman?
Chaypina Felipika aynirkan: —Tukuy shunku Jesukristuta kreyiptikika bawtisashkayki. Chashna willaptin chay runaka aynirkan: —Ñukaka kreyini Jesus Tata Diospa wambran kananta.
Chashna willaptin Felipika almitirkan bawtisayta. Chaypina chay runaka karrunta shayachiptin ishkantinkuna chay yakuman rirkansapa. Chaypi Felipika chay runata bawtisarkan.
Chaymanta bawtisashkanwasha yakumanta llukshiptinkuna Tata Diospa Espiritunka Felipitaka suk partiman pusharkan. Chay runa manana Felipita kawashpapish kushikuypuru llaktanman kutirkan.
Tata Diospa Espiritun Asoto llaktapi Felipita churarkan. Chay Asotomanta rishpa llaktan llaktanpi Jesus yachachikushkanta rirkan yachachikuypi Sesareapi chayanankaman.
